proof_scope: Deterministic offline CLI boundary gates for the GoDaddy DNS skill

claims.proves: Zone validator enforces the >=2 NS API rule and rejects malformed records before any network call; diagnose emits the mail-auth verdict schema
claims.does_not_prove: live GoDaddy API mutations (require token; recipe proven live 2026-09-11 grahama.co)

cases.name: zone-without-ns-rejected
command: cd ../scripts && echo '[{"name":"@","data":"1.2.3.4","type":"A"}]' > /tmp/z.json && uv run --with typer --with pydantic python3 godaddy_dns.py put-zone --domain example.com --zone-file /tmp/z.json 2>&1 | grep -q 'MISSING_NAME_SERVER' && echo PASS_ZONE_NS_GATE

cases.name: zone-with-ns-validates
command: cd ../scripts && echo '[{"name":"@","data":"ns1.x.com.","type":"NS"},{"name":"@","data":"ns2.x.com.","type":"NS"}]' > /tmp/z2.json && uv run --with typer --with pydantic python3 godaddy_dns.py put-zone --domain example.com --zone-file /tmp/z2.json 2>&1 | grep -q 'missing_token' && echo PASS_VALIDATION_PASSED_TO_AUTH_GATE

cases.name: malformed-record-rejected
command: cd ../scripts && uv run --with typer --with pydantic python3 godaddy_dns.py put-record --domain example.com --rtype TXT --name '' --data '' 2>&1 | grep -qE 'string_too_short|min_length' && echo PASS_RECORD_FIELD_GATE
